_body:
Cue: attempting to list a directory that does not exist on the current system
Text: verify the target directory exists or use a known valid path like a subdirectory of the current working directory

Failed:
```
ls: impossible d'accéder à '/home/user/' : Aucun fichier ou répertoire de ce type
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"ls bin/","timeout":10}
```

Cue: When calling a command that may fail or needs exit code capture
Text: Append " 2>&1" to redirect stderr to stdout and " echo "EXIT: $?" to capture and display the exit code.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes 2\u003e\u00261; echo \"EXIT: $?\""}
```

Cue: Running make commands in an uninitialised workspace
Text: Run make bootstrap before running other make targets to initialise the workspace.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap"}
```

Cue: Missing database configuration in migrate.sh command
Text: Include the --db flag with the database path in the command string.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db","timeout":30}
```

Cue: When calling acme build
Text: Always include the --profile argument with a value of dev or prod.

Failed:
```
error: --profile is required (dev|prod)
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme build --profile dev 2\u003e\u00261"}
```

Cue: File not found due to incorrect absolute path
Text: Use a relative file path instead of an absolute path when calling the Read tool.

Failed:
```
Error reading /home/user/repos/evangelyne/lib/strings.sh: open /home/user/repos/evangelyne/lib/strings.sh: no such file or directory
```

Worked:
```
{"end_line":10,"file_path":"./lib/strings.sh","start_line":1}
```
